claims.sentence: In this 60-day oral study, male Swiss mice were exposed to polystyrene microplastics (Ps-MPs; 10 mg/kg b.wt), and the protective efficacy of taurine (Tau; 200 mg/kg b.wt) was assessed with particular focus on renal function, oxidative stress, inflammation, apoptosis, fibrosis, and gene expression.
